Shared types and process-level globals.

All types that cross module boundaries live here to avoid import cycles. experimentalEnabled is a global because every module that validates a profile needs it, and threading it through every call site is noise.

Types

Action = object
  kind*: ActionKind
  path*: string
  body*: string
  stdin*: string             ## bash-only: piped to the command's stdin
  edits*: seq[(string, string)]
  plan*: seq[PlanItem]
  summary*: string           ## context_clear: summary of current state
  instructions*: string      ## context_clear: instructions for fresh context
  offset*: int
  limit*: int
The parsed, tool-agnostic representation of a single model tool call. runAction in actions.nim consumes this and produces the tool result. 
ActionKind = enum
  akBash, akRead, akWrite, akPatch, akApplyPatch, akPlan, akWebSearch,
  akWebFetch, akContextClear, akError
ApiError = object of CatchableError
LoopTracker = object
  ring*: seq[tuple[fp: string, mut: bool]]
  mutCounts*: CountTable[string]
  strike*: int
  trippedPaths*: seq[string]
  recoveryCmd*: string
  turnCalls*: int
Sliding-window per-path saturation detector. Only mutations (write, patch, sed -i, redirects, etc.) and web calls are tracked — reads are observation and excluded. Reset at the start of each user turn via resetLoopTracker. 
ParseIssue = object
  line*: int
  msg*: string
A syntax problem the text-mode parser surfaced on a fenced block (unterminated fence, orphan code-fence, malformed SEARCH/REPLACE). line is 1-indexed into the assistant reply. 
PlanItem = object
  text*: string
  status*: string
One item in a model-emitted update_plan / todo list. 
Profile = object
  name*, url*, key*, model*: string
  family*, version*, variant*: string
  reasoning*: string         ## reasoning/thinking effort level: "low", "medium",
                             ## "high", or "" when the model has no such knob.
                             ## Mapped to a wire field in `callModel` per family
                             ## (gpt-oss: `reasoning_effort`; glm: `thinking.type`).
model is the full wire value sent in the API model field (e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-120b"). Display code shortens it with shortModel(model) (everything after the last /). family ("glm" / "qwen" / "gpt-oss") drives (prompt, tools) tuple selection. version and variant (e.g. "3", "480b") are informational tags from KnownGoodCombos. In experimental mode family may also come from the per-provider config override. 
ReadCache = ref object
  state*: Table[string, (Time, int)]
Session = object
  usage*: Usage
  lastPromptTokens*: int
  toolLog*: seq[ToolRecord]
  savePath*: string
  profileName*: string
  created*: string
  cwd*: string
  plan*: seq[PlanItem]
  loop*: LoopTracker
  readCache*: ReadCache
ToolRecord = object
  banner*: string
  output*: string
  code*: int
  kind*: ActionKind
Usage = object
  promptTokens*, completionTokens*, totalTokens*, cachedTokens*: int
